BALANCE_RETENTION.title: High Balance Retention Program
BALANCE_RETENTION.objective: Protect the bank's most valuable deposit relationships.
BALANCE_RETENTION.action: Assign a relationship manager and offer a preferential interest rate review within 7 days.

SENIOR_BANKING.title: Senior Citizen Banking Benefits
SENIOR_BANKING.objective: Improve retention among senior, typically loyal, customers.
SENIOR_BANKING.action: Enroll the customer in the senior banking program and schedule a courtesy call.

LOYALTY_REWARDS.title: Loyalty Rewards Program
LOYALTY_REWARDS.objective: Reward long-term customers to reduce attrition of tenured accounts.
LOYALTY_REWARDS.action: Enroll in the loyalty rewards tier matching their tenure and notify via email/SMS.

REACTIVATION_PROGRAM.title: Inactive Customer Reactivation Program
REACTIVATION_PROGRAM.eligibility: Customers who are not active members.
REACTIVATION_PROGRAM.objective: Re-engage dormant customers before they fully churn.
REACTIVATION_PROGRAM.action: Trigger a reactivation campaign with a limited-time cashback offer and a personal outreach call.

DIGITAL_BANKING.title: Digital Banking Adoption Program
DIGITAL_BANKING.eligibility: Inactive or low-engagement customers who could benefit from digital channels.
DIGITAL_BANKING.objective: Increase engagement through convenient digital touchpoints.
DIGITAL_BANKING.action: Offer guided onboarding to the mobile app with a first-transaction cashback incentive.

LOW_PRODUCT_EXPANSION.title: Single Product Cross-Sell Program
LOW_PRODUCT_EXPANSION.objective: Deepen the relationship to increase switching costs and reduce churn risk.
LOW_PRODUCT_EXPANSION.action: Offer a bundled product package (savings + card) with a discounted first-year fee.

RELATIONSHIP_PRICING.title: Multi-Product Relationship Pricing
RELATIONSHIP_PRICING.objective: Address dissatisfaction sometimes seen in highly cross-sold customers by simplifying and rewarding the relationship.
RELATIONSHIP_PRICING.action: Review the customer's total product fees and offer consolidated relationship pricing.

CREDIT_BUILDING.title: Credit Score Improvement Support
CREDIT_BUILDING.objective: Support customers in improving creditworthiness, increasing long-term loyalty.
CREDIT_BUILDING.action: Offer a free credit counselling session and a secured credit-building product.

CUSTOMER_CARE.title: General Relationship Management
CUSTOMER_CARE.objective: Maintain baseline engagement and satisfaction across the customer base.
CUSTOMER_CARE.action: Schedule a routine relationship check-in call within 30 days.
